protocol.cohort: Eligible same-team/position segments formed before the entire test week. Recorded appearances only; absent/mismatched-team rows remain unresolved, never zero.
protocol.features: Earlier box scores and team opportunities only. No retrospective starting-QB names, injury assumptions, current-game totals or player appearances.
protocol.intervals: Earlier out-of-sample residuals only. Conditional central 80% empirical ranges, not guaranteed coverage.
protocol.uncertainty: Exploratory paired week-block bootstrap; not adjusted for six groups or all research choices.
protocol.baseline: Serving recency-weighting formula applied to workload records, plus last-three and last-six means. Not a comparison with live yardage probabilities.
protocol.limits: Retrospective source vintage and schedule; not a historical point-in-time data archive. No price/ROI, participation probability, yardage edge or AI-superiority claim. No automatic model promotion.
